summary: Sysco Corporation and co-issuer Sysco Holdings Corporation filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement for a large multi-tranche senior notes offering. On September 22, 2026, the issuers priced seven USD tranches totaling $10.75 billion — 5.450% 2029s ($1.75B), 5.600% 2031s ($2.0B), 5.800% 2033s ($1.5B), 5.950% 2036s ($2.0B), 6.400% 2046s ($1.0B), 6.500% 2056s ($1.75B), 6.600% 2066s ($0.75B) — plus two C$750 million CAD tranches, 4.250% 2030s and 4.800% 2034s. Goldman Sachs, TD Securities, BofA, J.P. Morgan and Wells Fargo are representatives, with subsidiary guarantees. This is routine debt capitalization, not a special situation; watch leverage and refinancing risk.
